title: Viridian Artists
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: At Viridian we have a Director who curates exhibitions. We are unlike cooperative galleries, in that our artists don't need to sit at their own shows, write their own pr, create gallery listings or promotions, etc. Viridian Artists can help with gallery work if they want to reduce their dues a bit. This is an important distinction because all of the exhibit related tasks are done for them.
